spans.s:
वैचित्त्यं^1 Grief, mental
distraction, sorrow; व्रजति विरहे वैचित्त्यं नः
प्रसीदति संनिधौ

.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: cf AP. MW and PW have vEcitya as wrongly written for vEcittya..

वैचित्र्यं [विचित्रस्य भावः ष्यञ्]
1
Variety, diversity.
--2
Manifoldness.
--3 Strangeness.
--4
Strikingness; as in वाच्यवैचित्र्य K.
